verdict.rationale: Codegen's own docs have a dedicated MCP servers integration page saying users can "Integrate any MCP-compatible server to extend agent functionality". Other pages mention custom MCP tools and provisioning MCP servers across an org, so plugging external MCP servers in as agent tools is a first-party capability. The evidence is short marketing-level snippets rather than detailed setup docs. Missing for 10: configuration details (transport types, auth, per-server tool controls), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
